thread:
sarah (Design): quick design review request: heatmap in Insights (usage by hour/day) — product wants keyboard nav and SR friendliness before we ship the compact view. noticing a few issues in the prototype: no visible focus on cells, tooltips duplicate SR output, and legend color labels are ambiguous for low-vision users.

 tom (Eng): can repro the missing focus. cells are divs with tabindex=0 but focus outline is disabled by global reset. also aria roles are missing. currently it's: `<div class=\"heat-cell\" tabindex=\"0\">` nothing else.

 leo (Accessibility): quick checklist: 1) use semantic grid roles: `role=\"grid\"` on container, `role=\"row\"` on rows, `role=\"gridcell\"` on cells. 2) prefer roving tabindex or arrow-key handling to avoid tabbing through dozens of cells. 3) visible focus indicator >=2px, high contrast. 4) SR announcement should include row/column label + value, e.g. \"Mon, 3pm, 42 events.\" 5) legend must include numeric buckets (e.g., \"10-19\") next to swatches and an optional pattern overlay for color-deficient palettes.

 maya (PM): context: analysts often demo specific cells — arrow-key navigation would be great. timeline: we'd like this in the next sprint.

 tom (Eng): implementation plan: switch to `role=\"grid\"` + roving tabindex using `aria-activedescendant` pattern or JS-managed tabindex. will add keyboard handlers for Arrow{Up,Down,Left,Right} and Home/End. sample snippet: ```js
// pseudo
grid.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key.startsWith('Arrow')) moveActiveCell(e.key);
});
```

 leo (Accessibility): for SR announcements prefer updating a single `aria-live=\"polite\"` region with a succinct message instead of verbose tooltips. avoid `aria-live` on each cell. also `aria-selected` on the active cell helps SR users know context.

 sarah (Design): accessibility UX q: when a cell is focused should the tooltip appear visually? i worry about tooltip obscuring neighboring cells. maybe show a light halo + small info panel below grid instead.

 tom (Eng): agreed — simpler to show the small info panel anchored below the grid that updates on focus/hover. keeps layout stable.

 leo (Accessibility): perfect. ensure the panel has `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"` and `aria-atomic=true` so screen readers get the single update. keep the message to 3 parts: day, hour, value. e.g., \"Tuesday, 14:00, 73 events.\"

 a11y-bot: automated-check: grid semantics => MISSING roles, keyboard-focus-outline => FAIL (outline suppressed), legend contrast => WARN (some swatches rely on color only), tooltip duplication => WARN. suggested fixes appended.

 maya (PM): acceptance criteria: 1) grid uses `role=\"grid\"` and `gridcell` semantics; 2) arrow-key nav implemented with roving tabindex; 3) visible 2px focus ring on active cell; 4) single status panel for SR+visual focus updates; 5) legend shows numeric buckets and pattern option. target: add to sprint and ship by end of cycle.

 tom (Eng): i'll draft a PR with keyboard handler, semantic roles, and the status panel. will include unit tests for keyboard navigation and an Axe snapshot.

 sarah (Design): small design ask: can we include an optional high-contrast toggle that swaps to a colorblind-friendly palette and adds diagonal hatch overlays on high-density cells? think it's useful for analysts.

 leo (Accessibility): yes — implement as a toggle that applies an alternate CSS class; ensure we don't rely on color only and that the legend updates to indicate pattern meaning. also expose the toggle with an accessible label: `aria-label=\"Toggle high contrast heatmap\"` and keyboard focus.

 tom (Eng): noted. PR will include a11y tests and screenshots for both palettes. linking drafts when ready.

 maya (PM): thanks everyone. i'll add acceptance criteria to the ticket and prioritize.

 a11y-bot: follow-up-scan scheduled for QA. automated tests will re-run after PR merge.
